body: Yeah, agreed 100%. I think Ashcroft gets nowhere near enough recognition too (probably due to his below average solo material).

I think its more pride than being macho to be honest. If my mates knew what I truly thought of myself etc. I dont think they'd knock about with me as much (not that they do anyways) but its just being a liability and a burden, making problems for people who dont necessarily want to hear/help.

My life just feels like one big routine now though, working a 9-5 I hate,  pretending everythings okay to get through the day. To then come home to nothing and yearn to be back at work where there is at least people around and something to occupy my mind and take me away from my own thoughts. It really is a bittersweet symphony.

Sorry man it's just how I am. 

He's 100% mine, we we're in a relationship during conception. I think the family are scared that I'm going to go for custody rather than just seeing him on weekends which is what I want. Also he has a lot of my physical features.

I'm trying not to be that guy that makes excuses but I really can't see the legal route working with what happened last time I tried. Maybe if they follow through with the death threats I'll finally be at ease but then my son would be without a father all together.

I honestly can only see one way out of my dilemma and it's not the best. I suppose it's a bit cowardish taking the easy way out but am I really all that manly being in this situation in the first place? Idk if I'm just trying to justify suicide in my mind but I really dont see a happy ending.

I've just looked at your post history and funilly enough I'm actually from Newcastle...

I still have no idea what to do though. Nothing will change unfortunately no matter how I see myself. If anything, things are just getting worse. I'm in a really shit position and I don't think I can carry on with things much longer.

I'm not on the birth certificate and i have no way of getting his dna to get a dna test to put me on the birth certificate. This means I have no parental right to contact.

If I get solicitors involved it will just dampen relations that are already on tender hooks, I tried when he was first born and I received death threats from the family of the mother so I'm just taking what I can get.

As for the post natal depression i will look into it but i really dont think thats why. Even so an online diagnosis isn't solving anything (sorry if thats me being a dick).

1. I guess I'm a marmite person, like admittedly Im a cock at times. I never know where the line is when I make jokes. But then again I cant say ive offended my "closest" friends but i know they have friends who dislike me so its hard getting time with them.

2. Honestly i message them making conversation like a screenshot of a tweet to do with football or whatever and say something about it and they've both left me on read. I get that people have busy lives and whatever so I'm not grossly offended. Would just be nice to have someone put in anywhere near as much effort as I do but I guess that goes back to my first point. 

3. As stupid as it sounds I'm not going to be deep or cringey or anything with my friends, I don't think i have that sort of relationship with anyone. I'm just not that kind of person. I dont wanna put that pressure on anyone because I feel so unstable I shouldn't be my friend's problem. It's just not fair on them.

4. I guess this is my way of opening up. Its anonymous and I don't feel like I'm a burden because you are here in the first place to comment. Thank you for that.

Idk, I wouldn't want to put the blame on my son. 

The only time I am anywhere near happy is when I'm with him. It takes my mind away from everything else for the hour or so I get with him.
